confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Newcastle, NSW, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies strongly by season and event. The July 2026 window is winter, so accommodation may sit at the lower end of the range outside school holidays. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.2x beer, wine about 1.4x beer). FX came from the RBA homepage figure for 15 October 2026, not the daily F11 table, which I could not open.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Australian coastal city priced somewhat below Sydney and broadly comparable to other regional NSW coastal cities such as Wollongong and the Central Coast, with restaurant and accommodation levels typical of Australian regional centres.
